title: Grade 8 ARABIC — Listening for gist: Main idea. (Screen Drama)
body:
EPISODE PACKAGE
====

EPISODE TITLE: THE DAY WE GOT LISTENING FOR GIST: MAIN IDE RIGHT
SUBJECT / TOPIC: ARABIC / Listening for gist: Main idea.
GRADE: Grade 8
LENGTH TARGET: 5–10 minutes
LOGLINE: Learners nearly fail a real task linked to Listening for gist: Main idea. until they stop guessing and use the correct method.
SETTING: INT./EXT. Kenyan home, school, or market — present day

CAST
----
• FAITH — curious learner who jumps to conclusions (school or home clothes)
• BRIAN — careful friend who checks evidence (everyday clothes)
• MR KAMAU — adult guide who asks for reasons, not slogans (apron / lab coat / lesso)

STORY GOAL
----
Complete a practical task correctly using Listening for gist: Main idea.

WRONG WAY VS RIGHT WAY
----
Wrong: Guessing or copying a rumour about Listening for gist: Main idea.
Right: Naming the idea correctly and applying a clear step-by-step check

SCENES
----

SCENE 1 — OPENING — DAY
FAITH enters with a clear goal: Complete a practical task correctly using Listening for gist: Main idea.. Camera follows hands and faces.
FAITH: "If I finish this today, I will finally understand it."
BRIAN: "Then stop guessing. Show me your first step."

SCENE 2 — OBSTACLE — DAY
A real-world obstacle appears. Props related to the topic are handled as real objects.
FAITH: "It looks easy. Watch me do it the usual way."
MR KAMAU: "If you are wrong, we lose time — and maybe more."

SCENE 3 — WRONG WAY — DAY
WRONG WAY: Guessing or copying a rumour about Listening for gist: Main idea.. The problem worsens. Meaning stays in action — no reading notes aloud.
FAITH: "See? That is what everyone says."
BRIAN: "And it got worse. Your idea is incomplete."

SCENE 4 — DISCOVERY — DAY
A clue appears through action — a label, a count, a safer method, a remembered rule spoken while doing.
BRIAN: "Look at what actually changed. Name it properly."
FAITH: "Wait… if that is true, I was checking the wrong thing."

SCENE 5 — RIGHT WAY — DAY
RIGHT WAY: Naming the idea correctly and applying a clear step-by-step check. Characters perform the corrected action step by step.
FAITH: "This time we follow the rule, not the rumour."
MR KAMAU: "I can see the difference already."

SCENE 6 — SECOND TEST — DAY
A new obstacle forces them to apply the idea again, proving it was not luck.
MR KAMAU: "We are not done. Another problem just arrived."
BRIAN: "Same idea. Fresh situation. Go."

SCENE 7 — RESOLUTION — DAY
Payoff: goal achieved. Characters show the result without a lecture voice-over.
FAITH: "It worked because we used the idea correctly."
BRIAN: "Say the reason in your own words before we pack up."

SCENE 8 — BUTTON — DAY
Final acted beat tying emotion to learning.
MR KAMAU: "Next time someone guesses, we will ask for the reason."
FAITH: "And we will check the evidence first."

REFLECTION BEAT (ON SCREEN, ACTED)
----
BRIAN: "What evidence shows you understood Listening for gist: Main idea.?"
FAITH: "A correct definition + one local example + one corrected mistake"

Study pages covered: 20 pages on Listening for gist: Main idea..
